name: Pumpkin seed oil
description: Oil pressed from the seeds of Cucurbita pepo, the common pumpkin

status.studiedFor: Male and female pattern hair loss

note.text: The 2014 trial in men tested a branded capsule; capsules, randomization codes and a grant came from its supplier.

bullets: **5α-reductase blocking** and antiandrogen effects reported in rats
**In mice,** oil on the skin raised hair growth scores over 3 weeks
**In people,** the mechanism is not established; DHT was not measured

practical.routes: By mouth (capsules); on the scalp in one trial in women
practical.monitored: Hair count and thickness, erection questionnaire (IIEF-5)

regulatory.text: Not an approved drug; dietary supplement
Herbal monograph: urinary symptoms, not hair

references: Cho et al., Evid Based Complement Alternat Med, pumpkin seed oil in men, Apr 2014
EMA, Community herbal monograph on pumpkin seed, Mar 2013
